# Shipstat

> Open source analytics & A/B testing for React Native and Expo. A native module sends the events you choose, in JSON batches, to the API you choose. A static dashboard analyses them in the browser with DuckDB. No autocapture.

## Install
- Expo: `npx expo install shipstat` (native module: needs a development build, not Expo Go). Bare RN: `npm install shipstat && npx pod-install`.
- Local receiver + dashboard: `npx shipstat-dashboard` → events on http://localhost:8787/events, dashboard on http://localhost:8787.

## API (import Shipstat from 'shipstat')
- `init({ endpoint, headers?, flushAt?=50, flushIntervalMs?=10000, maxQueueSize?=10000, enabled?=true, compress?=false, debug?=false })` — call once at module level in the app entry.
- `track(name: string, props?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | Array<…>>)` — flat props only, never throws, ≈ 1 µs on the JS thread.
- `setContext(ctx)` / `unsetContext(...keys)` — merged into every following event, persisted. Set before the first track (module level or useState initializer), not only in a top-level useEffect.
- `identify(userId | null)` — internal user id after sign-in; null on sign-out.
- `setEnabled(bool)` — user opt-out; disabling deletes waiting events.
- `reset()`, `flush(): Promise<void>`, `getAnonId(): string`.
- Added automatically to each event: app_version, build, ota, platform, os_version, device_model, locale, sdk_version.

## Conventions
- Event names: snake_case object_action, past tense (`paywall_viewed`, `purchase_done`). 10–25 events covering lifecycle, activation, core actions, monetization, retention.
- No personal data in props or context. No screen or tap autocapture.
- A/B tests: put the variant in context (`setContext({ variant })`), track an exposure event and a goal event.

## Event format
POST <endpoint>, JSON: `{ "schema": 1, "sent_at": ISO, "events": [{ id, name, ts, anon_id, user_id, props, context }] }`. 2xx accepts; 4xx (except 408/429) drops; 408/429/5xx/network retried with backoff. Optional `Content-Encoding: gzip`.

## Migrating from Vexo or PostHog
- Vexo: replace `from 'vexo-analytics'` with `from 'shipstat/vexo'` and pass the Shipstat endpoint URL to `vexo()` instead of the Vexo key. All Vexo calls keep working; replay/heatmap calls are no-ops. Guide: docs/migrate/vexo.md
- PostHog: `posthog.capture` → `Shipstat.track`, `identify` → `identify`, `register` → `setContext`, `optOut` → `setEnabled(false)`. Keep PostHog for errors and flags if used. Guide: docs/migrate/posthog.md
- History: `npx shipstat-dashboard import vexo --app <id> --token vexo_pat_...` or `npx shipstat-dashboard import posthog --project <id> --key phx_...` (add --dry-run first). Idempotent.
